## Leadership Team {#leadership-team}

The IDSWG is led by a volunteer leadership team drawn from pharmaceutical industry, academic medicine, and the broader biostatistics community. Leadership positions are appointed by Core Team vote, with nominations welcomed from the membership.

```{=html}
<div class="content-section-alt">
<div class="inner">
<h2 class="section-title" id="organizational-structure">Organizational Structure</h2>
<p>The IDSWG operates through three layers of participation:</p>
<ul>
  <li><strong>Leadership Team</strong>, Chair, Vice Chairs, and Co-Leaders set strategic direction, represent the group externally, and support sub-team leads. The team holds regular quarterly meetings.</li>
  <li><strong>Core Team</strong>, Composed of sub-team chairs and initiative leaders. Coordinates activity across the group and shapes the scientific agenda. Initiative leaders were added to the Core Team in 2025.</li>
  <li><strong>Sub-teams and Initiatives</strong>, Volunteer-driven working groups focused on specific methodological or operational topics. Members may observe, contribute, lead, or propose new groups at any time. See the <a href="subteams.qmd">Sub-teams page</a> for a full listing.</li>
</ul>
<p>Any member considering a new sub-team or stepping into a leadership role is encouraged to prepare a one-page concept and schedule a 30–60 minute consultation with the leadership team.</p>
</div>
</div>
```

## Membership {#membership}

Current membership stands at approximately **200 members** representing pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, contract research organizations, academic medical centers, health authorities, and patient advocacy organizations across the United States, Europe, and Japan.

Patient advocates are full and valued members of the IDSWG, not external consultants. The group's Patient Engagement Sub-team (currently seeking a new leader) focuses specifically on ensuring that trial designs reflect patient priorities, burden, and experience. Embedding patient perspectives from the earliest design stages is a core principle of the group's work.

Membership is open and free of charge. To join or update contact information, reach out to the leadership team directly or connect via the [get involved form](https://forms.gle/htzA2sGdJ6X9YfXU7).

## About DahShu {#about-dahshu}

The IDSWG operates under the **DahShu** umbrella, a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing data science in drug development and healthcare. DahShu hosts an annual Data Science Symposium and supports multiple scientific working groups. More information is available at [dahshu.wildapricot.org](https://dahshu.wildapricot.org).
